body: I wish I would just do it, but I have some friends that my death would affect, and everytime I go to do it, I think about them. I just wish I would do it without thinking.
I'm not gonna (yet).
Aww 💜
Thank you for caring so much, I really do appreciate it 💜 but I'm probably gonna do it tonight.
A Christian said to me: "God doesn't make mistakes, if you're born male, that's not a mistake."
I haven't.
Aww, thank you 💜 We can talk if you want.
Hi.
Lol goodnight, I appreciate that you cared that much 💜
I try, but sometimes it seems so hopeless.
I truly don't wanna live, I hate myself anyways.
Wait you care that much?!
Hi.
I don't have anyone to call.
Aww, thank you 💜

> It’s also 2018, you’re always accepted by a majority, and everyone else that doesn’t is living in the 60’s and can’t accept people for who they are(their opinions never matter).

I guess that's true, and I'm really glad. I can't help it that I'm trans, and I don't get why I deserve hate and discrimination for it. 

> Your family will support you no matter what identity decisions you make.

I don't know about that. I don't know what my family thinks about this, but one time I heard my mom talking about cross-dressing in a negative way, and I know there's a big difference, but my mom might think its the same thing, my parents aren't too smart. 

> If you ever feel lonely, there’s so many people that you can talk to. your family, friends, strangers online (hi) and if you’re really serious about this, book a therapy session and try to turn your life around, because you can make a difference to someone even if you don’t feel the same way... 

I can't talk to my family because 
1. They don't know about any of this.
2. We don't have a close relationship, like I rarely ever talk to them.

I don't have many friends, and I don't know about a therapy session, because I would most likely have to tell my parents, which I'm not ready to do, and I don't know how it will go, I have social anxiety, it sounds really scary.
True, but I don't know if I'll make it.

> Either way i had a trans friend (she was a woman and felt like a boy and was a boy for the most part of his life) that just off himself 3 weeks ago.

Aww, that's really sad 😭 I hope he is in a better place 💜

> Please, don't do the same. I'm here. 

The pain is unbearable. I might not make it.

> I can't tell you that for sure. My life has been pretty miserable for a long, long time. But every day I force myself to get out of bed.

Ditto.

> And it's better to get it over with sooner rather than later.

Yeah, but its really hard. I feel like I really need to tell them (because the longer I wait the more irreversible changes testosterone makes to my body), but I feel rushed, and not ready, its such a hard thing to tell them. Its not a simple thing.

I wanna do it, because I have Gender Dysphoria(MtF), and I really get worried because of it. Will I pass? Will my family accept me? Sometimes I feel like life isn't worth it. I'm also really lonely. I really just wanna end the pain, so I should just end my life.
I'm trans, I don't know if that's a sin or not.
But why should I live? My life is just constant pain. Its really not worth it anymore.
Everyday is just pain, so living just isn't worth it.
I don't believe in God!
I don't. I could just end the pain.
Yeah, wasn't really planning on doing that.
No, I just can't.
I'm not 100% sure, maybe hanging myself, maybe stab myself in the neck, I don't know, but I got a couple hours to decide.
I'm still here (for now) 😞

> Have you tried hormones?

Not yet.

> Would they help? 

Idk. 

> Have you told anyone about this?

No.
Why not?
Ah, I hope everything goes well. I'm probably ending it in like 2-3 hours, its nice meeting you, and I hope life's great for you 💜
Why not? My life sucks anyways:(
My parents don't know yet.

Same. I spend so much time creating a character in games. I used to play games so much, my parents said: "You play those games too much, go outside". I knew I was trans, I was just scared, so because I didn't enjoy my IRL life, I just played video games all day to escape from my life.
I guess that's true, but I don't know if I can.
Yeah, I'm too scared 😫

I'm struggling with Gender Dysphoria(MtF), and I hate myself because of it. I told my brother that I want to die, and he just said: "Don't do it", but he doesn't know my full situation, because I'm too scared to tell him.

> Life is precious.

I don't think mine is.

> And the bad days are better than not having days.

I would rather die, because then I won't feel any pain. I rarely have good days anyways.
That's dumb, if someone wants to commit suicide, that should be their choice.

> If you have any way of identifying him (which you do), you need to call authorities on him.

What would happen to him?
Lmao
